# Stacktape Documentation

> Stacktape is an open-source infrastructure framework for defining serverless and container applications in TypeScript or YAML and deploying them to the user’s own AWS account.

Use the concise index below to locate the canonical documentation page for a task. For a single-file corpus that includes page content and generated TypeScript configuration reference, use [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).

## Start Here
- [Quickstart](/getting-started): Install the CLI and run stacktape init in your app: the shortest path to a first deploy.
- [Deploy an existing app](/getting-started/deploy-an-existing-app): Deploy an existing app to your own AWS account with the init wizard.
- [Resource catalog](/resources): Pick a resource: every resource with the AWS service it creates and what it is for.
- [Declaring resources](/configuration/resources): Understand how resources are declared, named and connected.
- [Connecting resources](/configuration/connecting-resources): Wire resources together with IAM permissions and environment variables.
- [Lambda function](/resources/compute/lambda-function): Configure and deploy AWS Lambda functions.
- [Web service](/resources/compute/web-service): Run containerized HTTP services on AWS.
- [Dev mode](/local-development/dev-mode-overview): Develop locally while connected to cloud resources.
- [Deploying stacks](/deployment-and-lifecycle/deploying-stacks): Understand deployments, stages, and lifecycle behavior.
- [MCP server](/using-with-ai/mcp-server-setup): Connect an AI coding assistant to Stacktape tools using MCP.
- [Command index](/cli): Look up a CLI command: every command grouped by task.
- [Going to production](/getting-started/going-to-production): Review production readiness, security, cost, and reliability.
